description: This Java test class `CborJsonTest` contains unit tests for encoding and decoding JSON objects and arrays to and from CBOR format within the Eclipse Ditto project. It tests various JSON data types and internal caching behaviors.

classes.name: CborJsonTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying JSON <-> CBOR serialization/deserialization functionality in the Eclipse Ditto project.
